verdict.rationale: Manufact's observability dashboard has a Gateway Requests view that shows every request through the gateway, refreshed every few seconds, with optional full payload capture. Observability is also exposed via the MCP server, and a community member praised the analytics shown in the demo. However, there is no evidence of aggregated call-volume metrics, per-user breakdowns or error-rate views, and on cost the docs show only a monthly spend limit while a community user reports no visibility into pay-as-you-go cost. Missing for 10: aggregated call-volume and per-tool analytics, per-user usage breakdowns, documented error metrics, cost/usage reporting, and analytics for consumed (not just hosted) servers.
